meta.name: develop-userscripts
meta.description: Use when building, debugging, packaging, or publishing browser userscripts for Tampermonkey or ScriptCat, including GM APIs, metadata blocks, permission issues, @match/@grant/@connect setup, ScriptCat background or scheduled scripts, UserConfig blocks, or subscription workflows.

copy.tagline: 构建、调试和发布浏览器用户脚本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你经常为 Tampermonkey 或 ScriptCat 编写用户脚本
copy.tagline_en: Build, debug, and publish browser userscripts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently write userscripts for Tampermonkey or ScriptCat

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能帮你编写、调试和发布 Tampermonkey 或 ScriptCat 用户脚本，包括处理权限、元数据块、后台脚本和订阅包等。
howto.when: 当你需要创建或修复浏览器用户脚本，或遇到脚本注入、权限缺失、GM API 行为异常等问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Tampermonkey 脚本，自动填写表单。
say.note: Claude 会生成脚本代码并指导你安装。

say.text: 我的 ScriptCat 后台脚本不运行，帮我看看哪里错了。
say.note: Claude 会检查元数据和权限设置。

say.text: 如何用 UserConfig 给脚本添加设置界面？
say.note: Claude 会解释 UserConfig 块的使用方法。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can help you write, debug, and publish Tampermonkey or ScriptCat userscripts, including handling permissions, metadata blocks, background scripts, and subscription bundles.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to create or fix browser userscripts, or encounter issues like injection timing, missing permissions, or GM API behavior.

say_en.text: Write a Tampermonkey script that auto-fills a form.
say_en.note: Claude will generate the script code and guide installation.

say_en.text: My ScriptCat background script doesn't run, help debug.
say_en.note: Claude will check metadata and permission settings.

say_en.text: How to add a settings UI with UserConfig?
say_en.note: Claude will explain the UserConfig block usage.
